mentions.name: Feral
mentions.description: This AI agent generates promotional content for social media designed to deeply resonate with a target audience. It wraps LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT in a marketing harness that handles business context, angle discovery, and tracking of previous posts, so it can produce a reliable stream of varied posts instead of converging, repetitive, salesy output.
mentions.problem: Using Claude and ChatGPT directly yields only a few good posts: after 10–15 outputs the angles converge, the language repeats, everything becomes too salesy, and the user must manually provide business context, find angles, and track previous posts.
mentions.audience: People with a business and a target audience who need promotional social media content
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building an AI agent that creates promotional content for social media, in a way that deeply resonates with your target audience. I tried using Claude and ChatGPT first, and they could give me a few good posts, but not a reliable stream of them. After 10–15 outputs, the angles converged, the language repeated, and everything became too salesy. I was still providing business context, finding angles, tracking previous posts.

It was clear to me that a marketing harness was needed around the LLMs for this purpose, and so Feral was born.

https://feralhq.com
